headline_stat.name: place cells (fraction of excitatory units, shuffle p<0.05)

stated_limitation: median Cohen pseudo-R^2 = 0.11, typical for position-only models of noisy spike trains

justification.dataset: DANDI 000044 Achilles CA1 linear-track session is the canonical place-cell dataset in the correct species, region, and paradigm.
justification.handling: Real data streamed via remfile, correctly restricted to the maze epoch with the dataset's linearized position and explicit excitatory/rate/peak/spike-count inclusion criteria.
justification.analysis: Occupancy-normalized rate maps, Skaggs spatial information, 500 circular time-shift shuffles, and an independent Poisson-GLM cross-check are all appropriate; only multiple-comparison correction is missing, which does not affect the overwhelming population result.
justification.correctness: Every headline number (137 units, 71% place cells, GLM peak r=0.964, median pseudo-R^2=0.11) reproduces exactly from the committed npz files, with no negative or impossible values.
justification.figures: Figures clearly show fields tiling the track, representative examples across positions, the observed-vs-shuffle separation, and GLM-empirical agreement, with units and sample sizes labeled.
justification.honesty: Claims are proportionate and examples are honestly labeled by their selection criterion, but the clean write-up omits an explicit limitations note (single session, in-sample GLM fit, no FDR), placing it at 3.
justification.verdict: A thorough, reproducible, canonical demonstration that an expert would accept with at most minor requested caveats.
